Single-story stucco ranch, attached two-car garage, smoke pushing from the closed garage door and eaves, two cars in the driveway, porch light on, dawn.
A single-story strip mall with a nail salon, a taqueria and a laundromat; smoke from the roofline above one storefront; cars in the parking lot; businesses open; afternoon.
A single-story strip mall at night, closed and dark; smoke from roof vents and around the front door of one store; empty parking lot.
A stand-alone restaurant; heavy smoke coming from the roof near the kitchen exhaust; a few customers standing in the parking lot; lunchtime.
A large concrete tilt-up warehouse in an industrial park; smoke pushing from around the closed roll-up doors; a few trucks parked; night.
A small auto repair shop with two open bays; smoke pouring from one bay; cars parked out front; morning.
A two-story brick building downtown with shops on the ground floor and apartments above; smoke from the second-floor windows; people on the sidewalk; early evening.
A ten-story hotel; smoke and fire showing from one sixth-floor window; cars at the entrance; afternoon.
An eight-story senior housing tower at night; fire showing from one fourth-floor window; most windows dark.
A seven-story office building; smoke from the roof mechanical area; parking lot full; morning.
A twelve-story residential tower; fire on a ninth-floor balcony; lit windows; evening.
A two-story garden apartment building with exterior stairs and walkways; fire showing from one upstairs unit window and smoke filling the walkway; cars in the parking lot; night, parking lot lights.
A three-story apartment building over tuck-under carport parking; smoke pouring out of the carport level and up the front of the building; residents' cars parked; early evening.
A two-story fourplex apartment; light gray smoke from the attic vents along the whole length of the roof; several cars out front; first light.
A row of two-story townhomes with shared roofline; fire showing from an upstairs window of a middle unit; smoke at the roofline; midday.
A three-story senior apartment building; smoke and orange glow from a third-floor window; a few residents standing on balconies; night.
A single-story duplex; fire showing from the front window of one side; the other side's door open; afternoon.
A two-story 1990s tract house with beige siding; fire showing from one upstairs front bedroom window with dark smoke rolling up the face of the house; empty driveway; bright afternoon sun.

A small single-story wood-frame bungalow with a front porch; orange glow behind the front windows and light smoke curling from the eaves; one pickup in the driveway; porch light on; dark night, streetlight.
A split-level house on a sloped lot; medium gray smoke from the attic vents and along the roof ridge; a minivan and a sedan in the driveway; kids' bikes on the lawn; early evening light.

An older two-story craftsman house; flames visible coming through the roof at the rear of the house, seen over the ridgeline from the front; a neighboring house about ten feet away on the left; mid-morning.
A single-story ranch house at night; heavy fire visible down the side yard at the rear corner; smoke drifting over the roof; front of the house still dark; one car in the driveway.
A two-story hillside home with wood siding and a large wooden deck, surrounded by oaks and dry golden grass; smoke and small flames coming from under the deck; steep narrow driveway; hot sunny day.
A single-wide mobile home in a mobile home park; fire showing from the end window; neighboring mobile homes about fifteen feet away on both sides; dusk.
A two-story house in light morning fog; thin gray smoke from the roof near the chimney and from the attic vent; two cars in the driveway; trash cans at the curb.
A detached wooden garage behind a single-story house, seen from the alley; fire through the garage roof; the back of the house about fifteen feet away; wooden fence; late afternoon.
A vacant single-story house with boarded-up windows and an overgrown yard; fire showing from one front window around the plywood; no cars; night.
A single-story ranch house; heavy black smoke pushing from a front window and the eaves; garage door closed; one car in the driveway; clear morning.

A small grass fire, about the size of a basketball court, on the shoulder of a freeway on-ramp; flames a foot or two high moving uphill in light wind toward a few oak trees; cars passing; hot afternoon.
A small grass fire, about a quarter acre, at the edge of a vineyard, burning toward a farmhouse about 100 feet away; light smoke blowing across the vines; late afternoon.
A small brush fire at night on a vacant hillside lot between two houses, about the size of a backyard; flames a few feet high; porch lights on next door; night.
A small grass fire in a strip of open space right behind a row of wooden backyard fences, about thirty feet long; fence boards starting to scorch; light smoke drifting over the rooftops; midday.
A small brush fire along a creek bank under a highway overpass, about the size of a two-car garage; flames in the blackberry and willow; smoke under the bridge; late afternoon.
A small field fire, about the size of a tennis court, next to a hay barn on a ranch; fire about fifty feet from the barn and moving toward it; dry golden grass; noon.
A car on fire in a driveway, parked nose-in close to the closed garage door of a house; flames from under the hood; morning.
A car burning under an apartment complex carport; other cars parked on both sides; night.
A motorhome on fire parked on a residential street; smoke and flames from the rear; houses across the sidewalk; afternoon.
A backyard wooden shed on fire; flames through the roof; wooden fence and the back of the house about ten feet away; late afternoon.
